title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 3:7-12
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 3:7-12</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: Rise of the Messiah (2024)
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="7" /> And seeing many of the Pharisaions and Saddoukaions coming out to his <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="cyan">immersion</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          he said to them, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          “You <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="black">seed</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">of snakes</char>! 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          Who directed you to flee from <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">the coming anger</char>?! 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          <verse number="8" /> So then, <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">produce fruit</char> worthy of a <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">change-of-direction</char>, 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="9" /> and don’t suppose you can say to yourselves, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          ‘We have <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">Abra’am</char> as a <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="black">father</char>.’ 
        </group>
        <group>
          For I tell you that God is able to raise up from these stones <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="black">children</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">for Abra’am</char>! 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="10" /> For <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="tan">the axe</char> is already laid at the root of the trees! 
        </group>
        <group>
          For every <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">tree</char> that does not <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">produce good fruit</char> will be cut down, 
        </group>
        <group>
          and into the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">fire</char> it will be tossed! 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="11" /> For I <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="cyan">immerse</char> y’all in <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="turquoise">water</char> for a <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">change-of-direction</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        but the one coming after me is more strong than me, 
      </group>
      <group>
        whose sandal I am not worthy to carry. 
      </group>
      <group>
        He will <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="cyan">immerse</char> you with the <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="violet">holy spirit</char> and <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">fire</char>, 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="12" /> whose <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="tan">threshing-fork</char> is in his hand, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and he will clear out his threshing floor, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and he will gather his <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">wheat</char> into the store-house, 
      </group>
      <group>
        but the grain-husks he will <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">burn</char> with <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">unextinguishable fire</char>.“
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
